description: Pupil Transportation Count of Employees Bus Company - July 1, - December 31, 2021 is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. Students are reported as those who were planned and routed, but may or may not have used the service provided. Student stop assignment is done at the school, OPT creates the routes. Routes were determined by those routed with students assigned Vehicles are identified by school bus company reported data. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Education. The table has 4 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Education (DOE). The portal shows 2021-01-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
